settings.logoAlt: Psalm 23 Transportation logo featuring a colorful puzzle-piece cross, white Ford F-250, and flatbed trailer

hero.intro: Whatever you need hauled, wherever it needs to go. Tell us about your load, and let’s get it moving.
hero.ribbon: YOUR LOAD. YOUR DESTINATION. OUR COMMITMENT.

services.intro: From a local pickup to a long-distance haul, start with the details. We’ll talk through your load, route, and timing to confirm what works.

cards.title: Equipment & materials
cards.description: Need equipment, supplies, or bulky materials moved? Send us the size, weight, and pickup details.

cards.title: Scrap & cleanup loads
cards.description: Have scrap metal, debris, or a load to clear out? Tell us what you have and where it needs to go.

cards.title: Your next haul
cards.description: Something else in mind? We welcome hauling inquiries of every kind, to destinations near and far.

story.paragraph1: Psalm 23 Transportation began with a shared calling to build something together. We’re a family-owned business founded by Isabella, her boyfriend, and her dad, with God at the center of it all.
story.paragraph2: Our name is a reminder of who leads us. Our work is an opportunity to serve others with care, honest communication, and a commitment to the job in front of us.
story.verse: “The Lord is my shepherd; I shall not want.”

quote.intro: Share a few details to start your quote. We’ll confirm the load, availability, and price with you directly.
quote.smallNote: Prefer to keep it simple? Text us directly.
quote.loadPlaceholder: Describe your load, approximate size, and any important details
